correctness.rationale: The all-n fiber matrix is derived independently. Perfect conditioning iff three nodes form cube roots, a known fact. For non-tight residue classes an explicit shift gives a first-order Hermitian perturbation. Every globally minimizing shift must approach an equilateral triple by Gram trace control; the arithmetic gap forces |d| at least 2pi/3. Convexity and reflection symmetry of H yield a sharp spectral diameter at a=d/2, proving the matching lower bound. Deterministic finite checker verifies the matrix expansions for selected n, but is not used for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: In 2025/2026 multi-tile Fourier Riesz research, explicit conditioning rather than mere invertibility is a motivated objective. This theorem quantifies the exact leading price of a forbidden perfect spectrum, including an explicit asymptotically optimal real frequency shift and a residue-class dichotomy for every growing geometric separation. The coefficient comes from a global constrained spectral minimax, not a small numeric increment or a mere restatement of known perfect-conditioning congruences.
